pop3.port.description: TCP port on which the POP3 daemon listens (typically 110 for unencrypted POP3).

pop3.ssl_port.description: TCP port for POP3S (POP3 over SSL/TLS).

pop3.ssl_start.description: Enable POP3 with STARTTLS support (port 110 advertises TLS after protocol initiation).

pop3.tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

pop3.tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format; often same file as certificate).

pop3.max_daemons.description: Maximum number of concurrent POP3 daemon processes.

pop3.cache_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) before cached authentication results expire.

pop3.auth_modules.description: Ordered list of authentication backends to try. Order matters.

pop3.allow_plaintext_auth.description: Allow plaintext passwords (e.g., 'USER/PASS') over non-SSL connections. Disable in production unless necessary for legacy clients.

pop3.require_starttls.description: Require clients to issue STARTTLS before authentication (if SSL port is also enabled).

pop3.max_message_size_kb.description: Maximum allowed message size (in KB). Set to 0 for unlimited.

pop3.uidl_unique_prefix.description: Unique prefix for UIDL values to ensure global uniqueness (e.g., base64-encoded domain or timestamp).

pop3.hostname.description: Hostname advertised in the POP3 greeting banner (should resolve correctly for clients).
